title: Mixture of Phonetic Experts Based Low-Rank Adaptation of Conformer Models for Accented English Speech Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.26888v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present Mixture of Phonetic Experts based Low-Rank Adaptation (MoPE-LoRA), a parameter-efficient adaptation framework for accented English speech recognition. Recent mixture-of-experts approaches typically allocate experts per accent, implicitly treating accent identity as the primary axis of variation. In contrast, we organize adaptation along phonetic categories, motivated by the observation that accent differences are often expressed as systematic distortions of phoneme realization. MoPE-LoRA introduces a fixed set of six low-rank experts aligned with manner-of-articulation classes and performs frame-level routing through a hybrid mechanism that combines phoneme supervision with learned acoustic gating. Because the expert set is shared across accents, the model does not require accent-specific modules and naturally extends to previously unseen accents. translated_title: 基于音素专家混合的低秩适配Conformer模型用于带口音英语语音识别
translated_abstract: 我们提出了基于音素专家混合的低秩适配方法（MoPE-LoRA），这是一种用于带口音英语语音识别的参数高效适配框架。近期的混合专家方法通常为每种口音分配专家，隐式地将口音身份视为主要的变异轴。相比之下，我们沿着语音类别来组织适配，其动机在于观察到口音差异往往表现为音素实现的系统性失真。MoPE-LoRA引入了一组固定的、与发音方式类别对齐的六个低秩专家，并通过结合音素监督与可学习声学门控的混合机制进行帧级路由。由于专家集合在所有口音之间共享，该模型不需要特定于口音的模块，并且能够自然地扩展到先前未见过的口音。在L2-ARCTIC数据集上的实验表明，MoPE-LoRA始终优于单个LoRA基线。
tldr: 该论文提出MoPE-LoRA框架，按照发音方式类别而非口音身份来组织六个低秩专家，通过音素监督与声学门控相结合的帧级混合路由，实现参数高效的带口音英语语音识别适配，并可自然泛化到未见过的口音。
en_tdlr: MoPE-LoRA organizes six low-rank experts by manner-of-articulation classes rather than accent identity, using hybrid phoneme-supervised and acoustic gating for frame-level routing, enabling parameter-efficient accented English speech recognition that generalizes to unseen accents.
